stageForest.title: ~ The Forest ~
dialogue: Ahh, after the mild night rain the atmosphere is still refreshing...
A perfect time to get some mushrooms!
Not so fast, bucko! You still owe me 20 euros!
Dammit, not you again... I told you i'm gonna return it at the end of the week!
You've been telling me the same tale a week ago. And two weeks ago...
So where's the money, Aster? Answer me.
Listen, Kate, i really have to go. I promise i'll bring the money later.
Nuh-uh. I'm either getting my money now or you're getting six feet under!
Resorting to violence, eh? Well, so be it.
Well, turns out i was stronger than you.
Huff, puff... I guess you won. But just this once!
And don't act like you're tough and shit! I am getting my money back next time!
Of course. But no need to get agressive again.
See ya, Kate.

stageRiver.title: ~ The River ~
dialogue: Well, that battle was exausting...
I hope this time i wouldn't be sieged by any surprise.
And here i am!
...Jinx it. What do you want, moron?
How darest thou call me a morone?! I'm the daughter of the nobleman Pascal and the most powerful mage in the area, by the way!
Élyzabeth-Rézé la Noëlle-Geneviève. But thou can call me Erlang, bastard.
I know what your name is and who you are.
I hear no reverence in the tone of thy voice!
Anyway, i tharf to try out new tricks of mine, so i demand thee help me out.
And look, i'm asking politely, bastard.
Not again...
Your tricks are kinda weak, miss Erlang.
Act not so high and mighty, bastard! The fact that thou managedst to beat me once proves nothing!
Yes, i accept my lose. But i'm still the most powerful mage! I shall prove it! I shall prove it to all!
Didn't even say "goodbye".

stageWasteland.title: ~ Wasteland ~
dialogue: A scorched wasteland where once was a burnt part of the forest... Brrr, creepy little place.
How did i even manage to get here?
SINULLA EI OLE MITÄÄN ASIAA TÄNNE. HÄIVY TONTILTANI, MUUKALAINEN.
Oh my God, what the hell are you?!
MINÄ, TÄMÄN MAAN SUOJELIJANA, EN SALLI TEIDÄN OLLA TÄÄLLÄ.
I don't understand you!
HÄIVY, HÄIVY. TÄMÄ ON NYT MEIDÄN MAAMME.
Aster, Aster! Ya aright?
Vector! How did you get here? And the hell was that?
Never in my life i've seen this kinda... thing.
Yeah, about that... I had a force majeure situation at work. This is a confident information, but since you've seen everything yourself...
Long story short: the Corrupted fled from the laboratory. Now they're walking around here. That one you've seen just now is more or less sentient btw, near the military checkpoint they're kinda wild.
That is why, incidentally, a curfew was imposed in the region. It's not because of the rise in crime.
The hell?! It nearly killed me! And i thought they don't exist anymore!
Nah, there's lots of 'em. Experiments are being conducted on them in secret..
Anyway, let's go. Ya help me clean up remnants in the lab, and i give ya a tour of my workspace while we're at it—maybe we'll even end up working together later. I heard ya need the money, right?
Refusal isn't an option: friendship is one thing, but you just saw something you shouldn't have. We'll both just get eliminated.
Fucking shrooms, i'd better sit home al day...
